question: Mohiniyattam is a famous dance form popular in which of these states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerela__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mohiniyattam is a classical dance form that originates from Kerala, India.
 
• It is known for its graceful movements and is traditionally performed by women.
 
• The dance form embodies the essence of feminine love and devotion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mohiniyattam translates to "Dance of the Enchantress" in English.
 
• It is one of the eight Indian classical dance forms recognized by the Sangeet Natak Academy.
 
• The dance is characterized by its delicate footwork and expressive eye movements.
 
• It traditionally tells stories from Hindu mythology, especially those centered around the Hindu god Vishnu and his avatar, Mohini.
